meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把当前代码（HEAD）与最新发布的 npm 版本对比，按三个发布层列出尚未发布的改动，用平实语言说明每处真实变化和影响，并给出各层的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你提到 “unpublished changes”、“changelog”、“what changed” 等关键词，或想知道还有哪些改动没发布时触发。它不会先提问，直接输出分析。

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和最新发布的 npm 版本，列出还没发布的改动
say.note: 按发布层输出未发布改动清单

say.text: 哪些改动还没发布？顺便给各层的版本号建议
say.note: 给出分层与整体的版本号建议

say.text: 看看 oh-my-opencode 从上次发布到现在改了什么
say.note: 读取 diff 并描述真实变化

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, lists unpublished changes by release layer, describes each real change in plain language, and recommends a version bump per layer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog" or "what changed", or ask which changes are still unreleased. It outputs the analysis directly without asking questions.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list what's unpublished
say_en.note: Outputs unpublished changes by release layer

say_en.text: What hasn't been released yet, and what version bumps do you suggest?
say_en.note: Gives layer-specific and overall bump advice

say_en.text: What changed in oh-my-opencode since the last publish?
say_en.note: Reads the diff and describes real changes
